item.title: Hubble 1.0.5
item.description:
Hubble 1.0.5
Hubble 1.0.5: faster editing and more reliable variables
- Make OGP Source-number changes appear sooner and speed up simple formula references. - Improve variable types and formulas, including text that resembles numbers, Boolean values, or errors. - Improve variable editing, validation, paste, multiline values, Boolean formulas, and Undo/Redo. - Keep background workbook updates from stealing focus or losing typed input. - Reduce repeated workbook, logging, and button-appearance work. - Fix action identity checks for repeated execution requests.
